headline: How to Get Tuckin
title: How to Get Tuckin in Aniimo | Hummin Evolution Trick | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Tuckin comes from Hummin, and it has a strange rule. Hummin must be level eighteen. Then go to the entrance of Sanctum Twisted Roots in the Mistwoods and use Dig In for twenty seconds. Doing it anywhere else will not count. Each Hummin needs its own dig. Most guides also list a Sprout Stone and defeating Omega Tuckin, so check your panel. Are you digging yet? Comment below!
description: How to get Tuckin in Aniimo: raise Hummin to level 18 and use Dig In for twenty seconds at the Sanctum Twisted Roots entrance.
